{{Quote|I'll be broggled.''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"[Thrawn is]'' right. It's signed with formal Frunchy script.|Dubrak Qennto and Maris Ferasi, on a Frunchettan-sai art piece|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
The [[Frunchettan-sai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] used a formal '''script''' that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Dubrak Qennto]] was familiar with. In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a Frunchettan-sai art piece marked with the script was present in the treasure room of a [[Vagaari plunder ship|starship]] of the nomadic [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] species. After [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] noticed the artifact and described the physical traits of its [[Artist/Legends|artist]] without being familiar with their species, Qennto confirmed the observation by noticing the presence of the script on the artwork.

==Description==
A formal [[Writing/Legends|script]] was used by the [[Frunchettan-sai]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Outbound" /> that originated in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Frunchettan system/Legends|Frunchettan system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Frunchettan-sai]]|system=[[Frunchettan system/Legends|Frunchettan system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and controlled a handful of [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CSWE Frunchettansai">{{CSWECite|I|297|Frunchettan-sai}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Frunchies, you think?''"<br />"''Yeah, right.|Maris Ferasi and Dubrak Qennto, before the latter heading to observe a Frunchettan-sai art piece closer|<ref name="Outbound" />}}
[[File:Frunchettan-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The formal script was used by the Frunchettan-sai species, which originated in the Frunchettan system.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dubrak Qennto]] was familiar with the script of the Frunchettan-sai, whom he referred to as the "Frunchies."<ref name="Outbound" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> a piece of Frunchettan-sai art that resembled nested [[tressle]]s and was signed with markings in the script was present in the treasure room of a [[Vagaari plunder ship|starship]] the nomadic [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] species used to transport plunder obtained through [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] raids. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Skirmish in the Crustai system|captured]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] by [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], also [[Core name/Legends|known]] as Thrawn.<ref name="Outbound" />

Later, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] captured Qennto and his crewmembers, [[Maris Ferasi]] and [[Jorj Car'das]], and made them his guests. He then utilized deductive reasoning to describe the physical characteristics of the Frunchettan-sai art piece's creator&mdash;without being aware of the identity of the [[Artist/Legends|artist's]] species&mdash;to the trio so as to illustrate the point of them inspecting the treasure room and identifying the origin of the artwork in it in order to try and recognize any of the species the Vagaari had come into contact with. Ferasi suspected the description matched that of the Frunchettan-sai, leading the skeptical Qennto to inspect the artwork closer. Upon noticing the presence of the script on the artifact, the Human captain expressed his incredulity at the precision of Thrawn's observation and wondered whether the Chiss, despite his prior claims, had in fact established contact with the Republic before.<ref name="Outbound" />

==Behind the scenes==
The script used by the Frunchettan-sai was first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound" />
